name: Dental Care Management System (DCMS), online edition
summary: A bilingual (Bangla and English) dental clinic management system with role-based access, conflict-free appointment scheduling, billing and printable invoices, consent management, and guest entry for patients to remotely submit intake details or appointment requests.
resume: Built a bilingual (Bangla and English) clinic system with role-based access, conflict-free scheduling, billing, printable invoices, consent management and online guest entry for appointment requests.
